اختزلوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَزَلُوا (iḵtazalū) /ix.ta.za.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# اُخْتُزِلُوا (uḵtuzilū) /ux.tu.zi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# اِخْتَزِلُوا (iḵtazilū) /ix.ta.zi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
